description: Search Reddit or read a subreddit. Use mode hashtag with a subreddit name (no r/), profile with a username, or search with keywords, plus limit 1-20. Every record is a post with kind, id, url, title, body, author, subreddit, upvotes, comments_count, created_at, members and source; at most limit posts come back. Comments, profile and subreddit records are not returned. upvotes and comments_count can be null. Send raw true for the full original records.

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

query.description: username (profile), subreddit without r/ (hashtag), or search keywords

raw.description: true returns the provider's own records instead of the compact shape

name: reddit
title: Reddit posts by subreddit, user, search
